cases.title: 2-D (refusal): a crossed quadrilateral made by the stated angles is refused
cases.expectRefusal: שנו את אחת הזוויות או את סדר האותיות
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused, naming «∠DAB = 70°» and «∠BCD = 110°», and ends «שנו את אחת הזוויות או את סדר האותיות».
cases.before: ABDC was drawn crossed, every row green.

cases.title: 2-D (refusal): the same, with the angles typed after the second quadrilateral
cases.expectRefusal: שנו את אחת הזוויות או את סדר האותיות

cases.title: 2-D: the quadrilateral with the two angles still builds, convex
cases.lookFor: A convex quadrilateral at each «הציגו תצורה אחרת»; never a dent at A or C.
cases.before: Some configurations drew a dent at C.

cases.title: 2-D (refusal): a circle through a crossed quadrilateral is refused
cases.lookFor: The circle line is refused with the crossed-shape message.
cases.before: Accepted; ABDC drawn crossed under a circle.

cases.title: Analytic (refusal): the crossed quadrilateral is refused here too
cases.expectRefusal: שנו את אחת הזוויות או את סדר האותיות
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same sentence as 2-D.

cases.title: 3-D (refusal): the crossed quadrilateral is refused here too
cases.expectRefusal: שנו את אחת הזוויות או את סדר האותיות
cases.lookFor: Refused with the same sentence as 2-D.
cases.before: Accepted; drawn crossed at most configurations.

cases.title: Analytic: «AB קוטר האליפסה» is understood
cases.lookFor: A and B on the ellipse, opposite each other through its centre.

cases.title: Analytic: «קוטר האליפסה AB» and «AB מיתר האליפסה» are understood
cases.lookFor: Both rows built: AB a diameter, CD a chord, all four points on the ellipse.

cases.title: Analytic: «AB הוא קוטר המעגל» is understood
cases.lookFor: A and B on circle O, through its centre.

cases.title: Analytic (refusal): a parabola has no diameter
cases.lookFor: Refused with «לפרבולה אין מרכז, ולכן אין לה קוטר…».

cases.title: Analytic: an ellipse's chip shows the foci only
cases.lookFor: The ellipse row's chip reads «הצג מוקדים»; no directrix option, no dashed directrix drawn.
cases.before: The chip offered «הצג מדריכים» and drew two directrices.

cases.title: Analytic (unchanged): a parabola's chip still has its directrix
cases.lookFor: The parabola row's chip reads «הצג מדריך».

cases.title: 3-D: an unlettered cube after a triangle takes new letters
cases.lookFor: A cube labelled D, E, F, G (with primes) beside triangle ABC; no error. (The cube row reads «קובייה»; the letters are on the canvas.)

cases.title: 3-D: «קובייה» typed twice draws two cubes
cases.lookFor: Two cubes, one on A–D′ and one on E–H′; no «כבר קיים».

cases.title: 3-D: an unlettered pyramid after a triangle takes new letters
lines: פירמידה ישרה שבסיסה משולש שווה שוקיים
cases.lookFor: A pyramid on DEF with apex G beside ABC, DE = DF.

cases.title: 3-D (refusal): «הקובייה» with two cubes asks which one
cases.lookFor: Refused: the drawing has several cubes, naming both, with «הקובייה ABCDA'B'C'D'» as the example.
cases.before: The second cube was never drawn.

cases.title: 3-D: a letter in two points' coordinates has one value
cases.lookFor: B and C at the same x, and «k = 1» puts both at x = 1.
cases.before: B and C drew k with two different values.

cases.title: 3-D (refusal): a letter that cannot hold a stated point is refused
cases.lookFor: «B(2t,t,k)» refused «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב».
